prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for both adoption redesigns and sign-in reordering, as only one test has been completed for each kind of change.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to the noise-corrected measurements in both rounds.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Account Persistence Clarification: Add explicit headline and body copy on sign_in explaining that signing in saves custom pets across re-installs and app restarts. (why: 8 support emails (the single largest support theme) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
1: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Pet Generation Progress Tips: Display time estimates and a tips carousel component during photo processing on the upload_photos screen. (why: Custom pet generation errors or confusion accounted for 3 support emails, and adoption has a long 1017s mean duration.)
2: [home, notification] Ready Desktop Notification Prompt: Enable desktop notification alerts on the waiting screen when pet loading completes. (why: Median wait time on waiting screen is 201s (mean 2336s), showing users switch windows and miss when their pet is ready.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Visual Path Comparison Spotlight: Switch choose_path layout to spotlight and add visual speed comparison badges for instant adoption. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with high mean duration (514s).)
4: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Milestone Completion Badge: Add step progress and verification badges to adoption_certificate screen before final pet spawn. (why: The adoption stage drops conversion to 60.9%, leaving over a third of users without completing pet creation.)

scores.note: Directly addresses top support theme (8 emails) with a low-cost copy change.
Targets largest funnel leak (1017s mean duration) supported by 3 support emails.
Solves long idle duration via notifications, but lacks support email evidence.
Addresses 23.8% choose_path dropoff, but requires UI redesign with funnel-only data.
Targets highest dropoff step (39.1%), but adoption redesigns historically showed minimal lift (+0.2%).
